p_bay.in.01.speaker: frank
p_bay.in.01.text: Same interval as last Thursday, Helen. Louder out here. Whatever it is, it keeps better time than I do.

p_bay.in.02.speaker: helen
p_bay.in.02.text: Steve would hear more in this than both of us put together. I’ll leave him a message.
p_bay.in.02.spoken_text: Steve would hear more in this than both of us put together. I’ll leave him a message.

p_bay.message.01.speaker: helen
p_bay.message.01.text: He should hear this for himself. We’ll bring the tape home, and he’ll tell us we recorded it wrong.

p_bay.tune.01.speaker: frank
p_bay.tune.01.text: There you are. Hear that, Helen? More than one voice, all holding the same note.

recording.voicemail.speaker: helen
recording.voicemail.text: Come out with us, kiddo. The bay is singing tonight.
